description: Slew limiter with separate times for rising and falling signals

params.text: Sets how long the output takes to climb toward a higher input, covering 1ms to 400ms although the tooltip reads up to 2000ms
Sets how long the output takes to fall toward a lower input, covering 1ms to 400ms although the tooltip reads up to 2000ms

notes: The slew is a one-pole approach rather than a straight line: the output moves fastest at the start of a jump and slows as it nears the new value.
